segments.name: Motorcycle Business
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells motorcycles across engine displacement classes and off-road vehicles for customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Honda produces a wide range of motorcycles covering various engine displacement classes.

segments.name: Automobile Business
segments.description: Manufactures and markets passenger cars, light trucks and mini vehicles, including hybrid, battery electric and fuel cell models.
segments.evidence: Honda's principal automobile products include the following vehicle models: (in alphabetical order) Passenger cars: ACCORD series, CITY, CIVIC series, FIT series Light trucks: CR-V series, FREED, HR-V series, ODYSSEY, PASSPORT, PILOT, VEZEL series Mini vehicles: N-BOX

segments.name: Financial Services Business
segments.description: Provides retail lending, leasing and dealer financing through finance subsidiaries to support product sales.
segments.evidence: The services of these subsidiaries include retail lending, leasing to customers and other financial services, such as wholesale financing to dealers.

segments.name: Power Products and Other Businesses
segments.description: Manufactures power products such as engines, generators and lawn equipment, and delivers HondaJet aircraft.
segments.evidence: Since then, Honda has manufactured a variety of power products including general purpose engines, generators, water pumps, lawn mowers, brush cutters, and tillers.

revenueModel.text: Honda earns revenue from external customers through sales of motorcycles, automobiles and power products, and from financial services including retail lending, leasing and wholesale financing to dealers.
